headline_item.title_zh: 欧四大电信巨头拟组建财团竞标卫星频谱
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 德国电信、Orange、沃达丰及西班牙电信正筹划竞标欧盟2GHz卫星频段，意在构建欧洲自主可控的卫星通讯服务以抗衡Starlink
headline_item.event_summary_en: Deutsche Telekom, Orange, Vodafone, and Telefónica are in early talks to form a consortium to bid for the EU's 2 GHz satellite spectrum. The initiative aims to secure a European-controlled operator status for the reserved band, effectively creating a strategic counterweight to SpaceX's Starlink in the consumer direct-to-device satellite market.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】德国电信、Orange、沃达丰、西班牙电信在欧盟卫星频谱拍卖市场（针对2GHz频段）：拟组建财团参与欧盟委员会组织的频谱竞标，争取自主经营权
【起因与机理】应对欧盟对关键通讯基础设施主权的监管要求，并削弱Starlink在欧洲直接连网市场的支配力
【核心事实细节】电信巨头拟组建财团竞标欧盟2GHz卫星频谱，以获取独立运营权。
【各方立场与态度】战略目标在于通过频谱控制权，迫使Starlink在欧转为下游分销商而非直接竞争对手。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Deutsche Telekom, Orange, Vodafone, Telefónica: Forming a consortium to bid for exclusive European-controlled operator status
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To comply with EU sovereignty requirements and challenge Starlink's market dominance
[Key Metrics] Spain’s Sateliot is seeking €150m to beam 5G to phones.
[Key Position & Outlook] Strategic leverage to force Starlink into a subordinate provider role in the EU market.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 欧洲电信巨头此举本质上是通过频谱准入壁垒，强行将Starlink从“基础设施主导者”拉回到“被监管的服务提供商”角色。若财团竞标成功，将迫使SpaceX在欧洲不得不通过电信联盟进行流量转售，从而有效剥离其对欧洲核心通信链路的渗透能力，这是典型的主权网络防御策略。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: The consortium strategy uses regulatory spectrum barriers to demote Starlink from infrastructure owner to a subordinate service provider. By controlling the EU-reserved band, these carriers effectively force SpaceX to operate as a wholesale partner rather than a sovereign network competitor, marking a shift toward protectionist infrastructure control.

headlines.title_zh: 英伟达遭美国证券交易委员会会计调查
headlines.title_en: Nvidia's accounting is a focus of US SEC investigation, sources say
headlines.event_summary_zh: 美国证券交易委员会正对英伟达会计实务展开调查，旨在审查其财务合规性，叠加公司高层治理危机，市场压力显著加剧
headlines.event_summary_en: The US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has launched an investigation into Nvidia's accounting practices. Enforcement staff are scrutinizing potential irregularities, a probe that compounds the company's existing challenges, including the leadership scandal and ongoing investigations into illicit chip shipments to China via regional partners.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】英伟达（NVIDIA）、美国证券交易委员会（SEC）在美国资本市场监管审查与合规调查：SEC对公司会计实务及相关财务记录启动调查
【起因与机理】公司内部治理失控叠加与其业务合作伙伴有关的芯片出口管制合规质疑
【调查与监管诉求】SEC执法人员正针对英伟达会计实务进行合规性审查。
【行业影响与走向】监管后续动作可能影响其全球地理营收报表合规性及长期市场估值。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] NVIDIA, US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) (US market regulatory probe): Formal investigation into Nvidia's accounting practices
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Corporate governance scandals and ongoing scrutiny over export control violations by downstream partners
[Key Metrics] The Justice Department has also been reviewing Nvidia's $12.
[Industry Impact & Outlook] Regulatory outcome may impact financial reporting transparency and long-term valuation.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 此项会计调查若深挖，可能揭示英伟达在过往财报中对于地缘政治敏感地区营收分类的模糊处理，这将成为美国政府强化技术制裁的“铁证”。该事件不仅是财务合规审查，更是美国监管机构对其全球供应链话语权进行清理与重新定价的政治博弈，英伟达作为AI核心基建的估值逻辑将承受长期压制。
headlines.industry_impact_en: If the accounting probe reveals obfuscation in revenue reporting related to geopolitically sensitive regions, it will provide the legal basis for further US tech crackdown. Beyond financial compliance, this intervention represents a systemic reassessment of Nvidia’s supply chain influence, likely leading to a long-term valuation discount for the AI bellwether.

headlines.title_zh: KKR拟斥资百亿美元收购EdgeCore，加码AI算力基建
headlines.title_en: KKR in Talks to Buy EdgeCore at Valuation of at Least $8 Billion
headlines.event_summary_zh: KKR拟通过旗下Helix平台以80亿至100亿美元收购数据中心运营商EdgeCore，以巩固AI算力供应链布局
headlines.event_summary_en: Private equity firm KKR is in advanced negotiations to acquire data center operator EdgeCore Digital Infrastructure from Partners Group, with a valuation between $8 billion and $10 billion. The acquisition, executed through KKR's Helix platform, aims to consolidate EdgeCore's 2.27+ gigawatts of capacity across key U.S. markets to meet the insatiable demand for AI infrastructure.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】KKR & Co LP（收购方）、Partners Group（出让方）、EdgeCore Digital Infrastructure（标的）在全球数字基础设施与AI算力底层建设领域：拟以80亿至100亿美元收购EdgeCore多数股权，获取其2.27吉瓦规模的算力基础设施储备
【起因与机理】通过资本杠杆整合关键算力资产，以满足AI行业激增的底层算力需求
【关键数据与实测】标的估值区间为80亿至100亿美元，涉及超过2.27吉瓦的算力容量。
【各方立场与态度】反映资本市场对AI算力物理基础设施的长期持有价值认可。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] KKR & Co LP, Partners Group, EdgeCore Digital Infrastructure: Proposed acquisition of EdgeCore at an $8B-$10B valuation, securing 2.27GW of infrastructure capacity
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Scaling compute assets to meet the surging demand from AI model training and deployment
[Key Metrics] Valuation ranges from $8 billion to $10 billion, covering 2.27GW of power capacity.
[Key Position & Outlook] Reflects capital market appetite for long-term ownership of physical AI infrastructure assets.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 本笔交易标志着AI基础设施重心正从单纯的芯片竞争转向“能源与空间”的物理资产壁垒争夺。KKR通过Helix平台引入英伟达与主权基金背书，不仅是在进行资产并购，更是在构建底层算力供应链的金融化闭环，以缓解AI基建中日益突出的电力瓶颈与交付周期压力。
headlines.industry_impact_en: This deal signals a shift in AI infrastructure competition from pure silicon performance to the control of physical assets: power and real estate. By leveraging backing from Nvidia and sovereign funds for the Helix platform, KKR is orchestrating a financialized closed-loop for the AI supply chain to mitigate the escalating power bottlenecks and deployment lead times.

titans.role_zh: Meta 首席AI科学家 / 深度学习三巨头 / 图灵奖得主
titans.event_context_zh:
纳偏差：它们比其他函数更喜欢生成某些函数。

正则化器只是强加了另一种偏差。

学习理论告诉你，你必须有归纳偏差，否则你无法通过合理数量的样本或试验学到任何东西（VC理论，没有免费的午餐定理）。

所以，从概念上、理论上、哲学上和实践上来说，正则化器都没有问题。
titans.event_context_en: @int_16h @torchedvision @MuzafferKal_ @mengyer @yingwww_ @choang333 @KuangYilun Regularizers are just a way to specify a
titans.quote_zh:
@int_16h @torchedvision @MuzafferKal_ @mengyer @yingwww_ @choang333 @KuangYilun 正则化器只是指定归纳偏差的一种方法。

您的模型架构和您使用的优化过程已经存在归纳偏差：它们比其他函数更喜欢生成某些函数。

正则化器只是强加了另一种偏差。

学习理论告诉你，你必须有归纳偏差，否则你无法通过合理数量的样本或试验学到任何东西（VC理论，没有免费的午餐定理）。

所以，从概念上、理论上、哲学上和实践上来说，正则化器都没有问题。
titans.quote_en:
@int_16h @torchedvision @MuzafferKal_ @mengyer @yingwww_ @choang333 @KuangYilun Regularizers are just a way to specify an inductive bias.

The architecture of your model, and the optimization procedure you use already have inductive biases: they like to produce certain functions more than others.

A regularizer merely imposes another bias.

Learning theory tells you that you have to have an inductive bias, otherwise you can't learn anything with a reasonable number of samples or trials (VC theory, no free lunch theorems).

So, conceptually, theoretically, philosophically, and practically, there is nothing wrong with regularizers.
